reference: Right now they are shaking hands on the sunny rooftop.
sk: Práve teraz si na slnečnej streche podávajú ruky.
cz: Právě teď si na slunečné střeše podávají ruce.
acceptable: {Right now|At the moment|At this moment|Now} they are shaking hands on the sunny {rooftop|roof}.
They are shaking hands on the sunny {rooftop|roof} {right now|at the moment|now}.

mistakes.text: {Right now|At the moment} they shake hands on the sunny {rooftop|roof}.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Výraz „práve teraz“ ukazuje prebiehajúci dej, preto Present Continuous: „are shaking“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Výraz „právě teď“ ukazuje probíhající děj, proto Present Continuous: „are shaking“.
mistakes.feedback_en: A time phrase meaning “now” shows an action in progress, so use Present Continuous: “are shaking”.

mistakes.text: {Right now|At the moment} they shaking hands on the sunny {rooftop|roof}.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Present Continuous potrebuje pomocné sloveso: „they are shaking“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Present Continuous potřebuje pomocné sloveso: „they are shaking“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Present Continuous needs the helping verb “are”: “they are shaking”.

mistakes.text: {Right now|At the moment} they are shaking their hands on the sunny {rooftop|roof}.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Shaking their hands“ znie, akoby trasú vlastnými rukami. Podanie rúk je „shaking hands“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Shaking their hands“ zní, jako by třásli vlastníma rukama. Podání rukou je „shaking hands“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Shaking their hands” sounds like they shake their own hands; the greeting is “shaking hands”.

mistakes.text: {Right now|At the moment} they are giving hands on the sunny {rooftop|roof}.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Podávať si ruky“ sa po anglicky povie „shake hands“, nie „give hands“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Podávat si ruce“ se anglicky řekne „shake hands“, ne „give hands“.
mistakes.feedback_en: In English people “shake hands”; “give hands” is not used.
